item.title: 'AILA': IIT Delhi Develops AI System That Can Run Lab Experiments on Its Own
item.description: Researchers at Indian Institute of Technology Delhi have taken a major step toward the future of scientific research by creating an AI system that can independently run laboratory experiments, much like a human researcher. In a study published in the journal Nature Communications, the team, working with collaborators from Denmark and Germany, introduced AILA, short for Artificially Intelligent Lab Assistant. item.title: Bangladeshi National Arrested in Sribhumi Raises Border Security Concerns
item.description: A suspected Bangladeshi national was apprehended by local residents on Tuesday night at Gach Kalibari Road in Sribhumi town and handed over to the police. item.title: India to Launch AST SpaceMobile’s BlueBird Block-2 Satellite Today
item.description: India is gearing up for another significant milestone in space technology as the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), through its commercial arm NewSpace India Limited (NSIL), prepares to launch the United States’ AST SpaceMobile BlueBird Block-2 communication satellite today at 8:55 AM from the Sriharikota spaceport. item.title: Hojai Administration Orders Foreigner to Leave Assam Within 24 Hours
item.description: The Hojai administration has issued an expulsion order against Abdul Majid, a 54-year-old resident of Borjari Maj Gaon under Jamunamukh police station, after he was declared a foreigner by the Foreigners’ Tribunal. The order directs Majid to leave Assam within 24 hours, in accordance with the Immigrants (Expulsion from Assam) Act, 1950. item.title: BlueBird Block-2 Mission: ISRO Launches Heaviest Satellite Ever From Indian Soil
item.description: India’s space agency achieved another major milestone on Wednesday as the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully launched the BlueBird Block-2 communication satellite, the heaviest satellite ever sent into space from Indian soil using an Indian rocket.
